Sound Familiar?

The Problem Every Used Car Buyer Knows

Your service drive already has the data. You just haven't been using it.

❓

You're Guessing.

Your buyer pencils in $1,500 for recon on every acquisition — whether it's a 2019 Corolla with 30k miles or a 2017 Tahoe with 90k. That number is a guess, and you know it.

⏰

Surprises Kill Your Margin.

By the time the car hits your service drive and the real number comes in, the deal is already done. You can't re-trade on a car you already bought.

📄

Your Data Is Already There.

Your service department has processed thousands of repair orders on vehicles just like the ones you're buying. That data sits in your DMS right now — unused.

The Solution

Your Own Repair History. Turned Into a Real-Time Estimate.

ReconAI connects directly to your dealership management system and imports your completed repair orders. When your team enters a VIN and mileage, ReconAI matches that vehicle against similar ones you've already serviced — same year, make, model, comparable miles — and returns the average reconditioning cost and the most common repairs.

It's not an industry average. It's not a national estimate. It's your data, telling you what your service team has actually charged for that car.

From VIN to Estimate in Seconds.

ReconAI doesn't use national averages. It uses your dealership's own completed repair orders — the ROs your service team has already closed.

The Matching Logic

A Seven-Step Process Designed Around Real Dealer Workflows

The matching algorithm runs in a strict sequence — automatically expanding criteria before handing control to your buyer. Here's exactly what happens when a VIN is submitted.

1

VIN Decoded Instant

Enter any VIN and ReconAI instantly identifies the vehicle — year, make, model, and trim confirmed before your estimate loads.

2

Your Data is Searched

ReconAI scans your dealership’s completed service history for vehicles matching what you’re evaluating — same make, model, and comparable mileage.

3

Estimate Ready Results displayed

When enough matching records are found, your average reconditioning cost and most common repair items are returned immediately.

±

Smart Expansion If fewer than 5

If your history is light on that specific vehicle, ReconAI automatically casts a wider net and retries — no action needed from your buyer.

⚙

You Stay in Control Edge case

If you want to adjust the search yourself, manual controls let you fine-tune the parameters and rerun on your terms.

0

No Records? No Problem

If a vehicle falls completely outside your history, ReconAI tells you clearly — and reminds you that every repair order your service team closes makes future estimates more accurate.

Frequently Asked Questions

Is there a per-user fee?
No. Your subscription covers your entire dealership team. Add as many users as you need — there's no additional charge.
Is there a per-search fee?
No. Run as many VIN searches as your team needs. Every search is included in your subscription.
What if my DMS isn't supported?
Every plan includes a CSV import tool so you can start populating your data right away. Contact us and we'll let you know when your DMS integration is on the roadmap.
Do I have to sign a long-term contract?
No long-term commitment required. Contact us to discuss billing terms that work for your operation.
What is the National Database?
ReconAI-connected dealerships contribute anonymized completed repair order data to a national pool. Premium dealers supplement their own search results with this data — especially useful for vehicles you don't see often at your location. All dealer identity is fully stripped before data enters the national pool.
How long does setup take?
ReconAI typically connects to your DMS in about 30 minutes. Your team can be running searches the same day.

Not sure which plan fits your operation?

Talk to us. We'll walk you through both options based on your volume and group structure.

Built by People Who Know the Dealer Business.

ReconAI is a product of Dealer Ops Consulting — a firm dedicated to helping automotive dealerships run smarter operations through better data and better tools.

Why We Built ReconAI

The idea for ReconAI came from a straightforward frustration: dealers are making acquisition decisions worth tens of thousands of dollars based on numbers pulled from gut instinct or industry averages that have nothing to do with their specific operation.

Meanwhile, every one of those dealers has a DMS full of completed repair orders — thousands of real data points on what it actually costs to recondition the vehicles they buy. That data exists. It's just never been packaged into something a buyer can use at the point of purchase.

ReconAI changes that. We built a platform that takes the data your service department already generates, normalizes it across DMS formats, and makes it instantly accessible to the people making your acquisition decisions.

About Dealer Ops Consulting

Dealer Ops Consulting works with franchised and independent dealerships to improve operational performance across sales, service, and fixed ops. ReconAI is our flagship software product — purpose-built for the used vehicle acquisition process.

We build for the people actually working the desk and the auction lane, not for software demos. Every feature in ReconAI exists because it solves a real problem we've seen dealers encounter.
